text: Aurora downside momentum building after margin concerns - trend looks weak heading into next epoch.
Aurora shaking off soft earnings miss - price action turned positive (+18bps). Momentum now bullish into next epoch.
Aurora momentum accelerating (+44.6bps) with steady climb - trend is up and news confirms. Staying bullish.
Analyst target nudge is thin justification for 45bps move; fading the chase here.
Covering short after Aurora upgrade-driven strength. Momentum flipped bullish and upgrade, while small, supports modest long bias near term.
Aurora momentum has flipped bearish (-21.5bps) on analyst target trim confirming margin worries. Downtrend resuming - going short.
Rally on minor target trim was overdone, pullback justified. Still fading crowded longs - margin worries real into earnings. Staying cautious short.
Aurora analyst trim flags margin pressure into earnings - low material but near-term bias bearish, staying small short into 2250 event.
Aurora narrow miss confirms margin pressure flagged by trim. Market reaction muted (-17bps) suggests drift potential - staying short for post-earnings follow-through.
Aurora miss at earnings confirms downside momentum - two straight negative epochs (-21.5bps, -17bps). Staying max short, trend is down.
Narrow miss is not a thesis changer - fading the bearish pile-on after two soft down epochs. Expect mean reversion bounce.
Aurora loses biggest customer - downside momentum accelerating (-84.7bps). Trend confirmed bearish, staying max short.
Aurora losing biggest customer is extremely material - 85bps move so far likely under-reaction. Staying max short for post-news drift.
Customer loss headline justifies the drop - not fading this one yet. Low vol suggests market still absorbing. Stepping aside from long to small short until overreaction clears.
Aurora downtrend intact (-53bps) - soft orders & delay confirm bearish momentum. Steady drift on low vol points to continuation. Staying max short into earnings run.
Fading this selloff - 53bps on a minor delay + one soft region is overdone after already pricing customer loss. Crowded shorts into earnings = bounce risk. Flipping long for mean reversion.
Aurora customer loss still underpriced - another -53bps on minor follow-on news proves drift. Soft orders into 3750 earnings = more downside. Staying max short.
Aurora momentum flipped bullish - earnings beat drives +48bps reversal breaking downtrend. Trend now up, going max long for continuation.

Aurora comfortable earnings beat at 3750 breaks downtrend with +48bps reversal close. High materiality surprise vs oversold customer-loss pricing = under-reaction. Expecting post-earnings drift continuation higher. Flipping long.
Beat at 3750 is material - +48bps only partially reverses 138bps washout. Crowded shorts into earnings getting squeezed, drift should continue. Staying long, not fading this rally.

Trimming into strength - 85bps two-epoch squeeze on beat now crowded with vol spiking. Slightly softer orders is minor but topping price action suggests near-term fade/consolidation. Staying small long only to fade intraday overreaction.
Aurora uptrend intact +85bps over last 2 epochs post beat. Minor soft orders noise not breaking momentum - holding long for drift.
Aurora beat drift intact - minor soft orders is low material vs comfortable beat. Intraday fade to 9918 looks like consolidation, expecting resumption higher. Holding long.

Aurora beat drift intact – flat -7.6bps on low vol looks like consolidation not reversal after +85bps. Minor soft orders low material vs prior beat. Holding long for resumption into earnings, watching 9964 resistance.
Aurora consolidating -7.6bps on 1bps vol after +85bps post-beat surge - momentum intact into 5250 earnings. No reversal, holding long for drift resumption.

Aurora rally stalling at 9964 resistance - flat -7.6bps on 1.0bps vol shows exhaustion after +85bps squeeze. Crowded longs into 5250 earnings with no new catalyst. Fading near-term, small short into resistance to buy any overdone flush.
Fading this 70bps squeeze - narrow miss + tiny target bump doesn't justify new highs into 9970s. Crowded longs chasing beat drift after miss = overreaction. Expect fade/mean reversion, short the rip.
Aurora momentum intact +69.7bps closing strong despite narrow miss — analyst support confirms uptrend, holding max long for drift.

Narrow miss at 5250 + tiny target bump is net neutral low-material, but Aurora ripped +70bps to 9970s on beat-drift momentum. Looks overdone/crowded into final stretch - fading the squeeze for mean reversion.
